note: Real programs, copied from public pages on the date shown. Amounts and dates change; check the funder's page before relying on them.

grants.summary: Small grants for grassroots groups in South Seattle, White Center, Kent, and SeaTac/Tukwila that build community leadership. $10,000 per organization, once a year.
grants.amountNote: $10,000 per N2N grantee organization (raised in spring 2026)
grants.geography: South Seattle, White Center, Kent, and SeaTac/Tukwila (King County)
grants.populationServed: Community members affected by poverty and racial disparities. Priority to efforts led by people of color, Black, Native, immigrant and refugee, and low income communities.
grants.eligibility: Community-based organizations with small budgets in the four areas above; one grant per calendar year
fundingPriorities: Community members leading change in their own neighborhoods
grants.deadlineNote: Quarterly: Jan 30, Apr 30, Jul 30, Oct 30. The summer cycle is paused; the funder says the application is expected to reopen in the fall.

grants.summary: Flexible grants from more than 90 donor funds for organizations in Eastern Washington and North Idaho. Most awards are $2,500 to $15,000.
grants.geography: Eastern Washington (10 counties) and North Idaho (10 counties)
grants.programArea: General (arts and culture, economic opportunity, education and youth development, health and wellbeing, quality of life)
grants.eligibility: Nonprofits serving Innovia's 20-county region. Not funded: academic research, debt retirement, lobbying, re-granting, litigation.
grants.deadlineNote: Closed for 2026. The last cycle opened Dec 1, 2025 and closed Feb 6, 2026, with awards May 25, 2026. The next cycle is not posted yet.

grants.funder: Community Foundation of South Puget Sound
grants.summary: Broad, flexible two-year grants for nonprofits working in Lewis, Mason, and Thurston counties. Awards are usually $1,500 to $7,500.
grants.amountNote: Typically $1,500 to $7,500; about $400,000 awarded in total in 2025
grants.programArea: General (arts and culture, civic engagement, environment, animal welfare, health and wellness, basic needs, economic opportunity)
grants.eligibility: 501(c)(3) public charities or fiscally sponsored groups with at least 3 board members; all grant funds spent in Lewis, Mason, or Thurston counties
grants.deadlineNote: Closed. Grants are for two years, so the program opens again in 2027. The posted cycle runs Aug 4 (opens) to Aug 29 (due), with awards in November.
